slides.title: Seer Score Adjudication Stack
slides.subtitle: Delphi3080 vs DelphiCursor vs the MiroFish public service — mechanisms, targets, trade-offs  ·  Marty Schoffstall, co-author

slides.title: 1 · What MiroFish set as the standard

bullets.text: MiroFish (OASIS + Graphiti agent society): claim → ingest into a Neo4j knowledge graph → specialist agents argue in rounds → ReportAgent issues a verdict
Targets: max-context reasoning, full social simulation, explainable rationale trail, graph persistence across claims
Cost: high — Graphiti ingest + embedding calls + 2-3 panel rounds per claim; ~15-30 min/claim on local 32B hardware
Our adaptation (Delphi3080) keeps the skeleton but re-targets: daily verdicts at scale for one tracker, not general research

slides.notes: MiroFish = the original agent-society adjudication design we inherited. Delphi3080 is our re-targeted instance.

bullets.text: Architecture: silent pythonw worker → claim fixture → Graphiti/Neo4j ingest → specialist panels (2 rounds) → ReportAgent verdict + confidence
Judge model: local qwen3:32b on nimo128 via llm proxy (embed-fixups live in the proxy)
Targets: zero marginal $ cost, always-on, batch all graded predictions; fail-soft (bad run marks error, queue keeps moving)
Verified: first end-to-end clean run Oct 7 — nickel 10x-demand claim REFUTED @0.65 (matches owner mark)
Weakness: 32B reasoning ceiling; embedding/ingest fragility (4 fixed failure modes today)
Architecture: fixture file (Marty redacted — judge blind) → Cursor agent CLI (Opus, may browse ≤2 URLs) → verdict.json → validated → merged
Targets: frontier reasoning on contested/deadlocked claims; breaking ties the 32B sim can't; calibration vs owner
Mode A (owner decision): advisory only — Marty stays FINAL; grid shows Delphi3080 and DelphiCursor side by side
Controls: 5-min hard timeout, ≤15 claims/day, single-instance lock, verdict schema validation, ≤2 retries
Status: worker/queue/check/display built (Cursor); API router + tests finishing; NO case submitted yet by owner instruction

slides.title: 4 · Differences vs the MiroFish public service
slides.notes: The stack: Fact-Check > Marty (FINAL) > DelphiCursor > Delphi3080 > Panel > Swarm.

shapes.text: 4 · Differences vs the MiroFish public service

bullets.text: Merge first Delphi3080 verdicts into the grid (hover tooltips ≤50 words live already)
Enqueue all current cases to DelphiCursor after QA; owner submits the first one
Enqueue escalation (V3 design): swarm split ≤30%, panel deadlock, Delphi3080 unclear → auto-priority
Porting: Delphi3080 moves to nimo128 Strix Halo with Qwen3.8-27B (GPU migration before laptop return)
Twice-daily 8am/8pm pipeline: harvest → gate → sweep → swarm → Delphi3080 → DelphiCursor → Marty → fact-check → report
